ev.q: Studies with the currently available vaccine formulation found a slightly higher prevalence of diarrhea (mostly mild) among vaccine recipients (3.8%) than among unvaccinated groups (1.6%)
This report provides new recommendations and guidance for vaccination providers and travelers
Through the GRADE systematic review, the Work Group found high-quality evidence that the vaccine is highly effective
